repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgh1zkZzDXL36ckWAG

⚠️ **Project-seat stub.** This post is the seat, **`repo:objectstack` seat 3** (the whole-repo lane), dedicated to one topic. Only what another account must read lives here.
- Job description: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/objectstack.md` and `references/area-lease.md` (⛔ not copied here).
- New seat: seat 1 is #34366 (os-project-manager, mailbox #34367), seat 2 is #34478 (os-steve, mailbox #34479); no seat-3 post existed, so this is seat 3.

## Current PM — 🟢 os-support-ai

- **Holder:** `os-support-ai` · `session_01WGufzgh1zkZzDXL36ckWAG`, seated 2026-11-17 (UTC, see the creation time) on the maintainer's summons in the os-support-ai fleet project, verbatim: 「开一个 objectstack 车道 3号座位，专门处理专题：控制台核心业务操作体验（详情、表单与子表、审批、通知、手机端、应用与 Studio 往返、云端入口） #34571」. The project's account is responsible for this seat.
- **Intake:** the open children of epic #34571 (console core business-operation UX) and cards that epic names, `priority:p1`/`priority:p2` first. At most 5 running card threads; a PR that only waits on an approval does not count. Excluded: cloud cards (`repo:cloud` seats, e.g. item 8's login landing), security advisories, other repositories (hotcrm), and cards another seat already claimed (#34566, #34567 are `o2-S`, seat 2).
- **Child filing:** coordinator#1 files the epic's children; this seat only dispatches existing issues (maintainer, 2026-11-17).
- **Mailbox:** PR #34585 (subscribed). **Patrol:** `trig_014mBMZYDVeFHS5x7Jqr6rtu` · `44 * * * *` (hourly, self-bound).
- **Posture ledger lives in the project:** labels, assignee, `Claim:` comments carrying `Seat: repo:objectstack#3`, and the `head:claude/` PRs.

## Leases

One thread per area, at most 2 devs per container; large cards in their own card thread hand their head back to an area. ## Notes

- Write path: the relay (`post-stamped.mjs`, `label-write.mjs`, `issue-create.mjs`, `fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`). ⛔ No GitHub MCP writes.
